node.law: supported product and CI runtime is Node 20 at or above 20.19.0 and below 21; CI pins the exact 20.19.x line; local runners must resolve a satisfying binary without relying on PATH shims

npm.law: npm with the committed package-lock.json is the only package manager path for repo verification lanes

workflows.law: every workflow setup-node step pins the single declared version; every action use pins the declared major

tempPaths.law: no fixed shared /tmp literal may appear in scripts/ unless registered with class and justification; new runtime temp uses os.tmpdir plus unique mkdtemp

verificationReadOnly.law: a verification lane must leave the git worktree byte-identical; tree change during a verification run fails closed
